chapter.li: LEChapter5 Verse1 The manner of administering the wine. Behold, they took the cup and said, VerseEnd Verse2 O God the Eternal Father, we ask 2PSI thee in the name of 2PSI thy Son Jesus Christ to bless and sanctify this wine to the souls of all those who drink of it, that they may do it in remembrance of the blood of 2PSI thy Son, which was shed for them, that they may witness unto 2PSI thee, O God the Eternal Father, that they do always remember him, that they may have his spirit to be with them. Amen. VerseEnd
